53f78b01c938.text: When a carp is nourished by the mother's milk and sleeps, and the carp also does not lay eggs, the carp can fly, except when the carp has hair.

3e4cf1dde260.text: Any complex number that requires talent and that is the species Ambiortus Dementjevi affects males, provided that the complex number is sad and does not have height.

3bd5cc8fefa5.text: An integer that is tall and that has a mutation requires talent as long as the integer has height, unless the integer steps on the stonefish.

079d0c2e4a71.text: Each project that loses its leaves in autumn and that flows to the Bronx belongs to the company, provided that the project is not extractive, except if the project has a wooden body.

91e79609d02a.text: Except when the film has a touchscreen interface, every film that is not displayed on the homepage and that is used primarily for communication is supported by independent research, provided that the film has its particles closely packed together.

2cc41e063acd.text: Anyone who has a lot of music decorations in their room, does not live in cramped residential buildings, and works at a pool is a student in the class unless they know how to use a queue.
2cc41e063acd.reference_fol_weak: ∀x (MusicDecorations(x, room) ∧ ¬LiveIn(x, crampedBuilding) ∧ WorkAt(x, pool) ∧ ¬Know(x, howToUseQueue) → StudentInTheClass(x))

3b31b66fe780.text: If a movie is biodegradable, is fungi, and has a spherical shape, then the movie requires frequent watering, but only if the movie has tracks on the back.

0128c50e163a.text: No opera singer who lives in North America, who performs at the New Haven Symphony Orchestra, and who does not know about breath-first-search publishes journals, unless the opera singer is uncomfortable.
